analysis.reason: 직전 2거래일 연속 매수 진입 후 현재가 45,885원 유지. RSI 34.5로 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램 2.3893으로 개선세 유지. 5일 저가 43,985원, 20일 저가 43,985원으로 Higher Low 패턴 형성 중. 변동성 ATR 6,434원 대비 손절폭 1.3배(8,364원) 설정 시 진입가 45,885원, 손절 37,521원, 목표 64,000원(손익비 1.5 이상) 설정 가능. 그러나 주봉 RSI 33.5, 주봉 MACD 히스토그램 -7453.6514로 여전히 약세 구간. ADX 30.4로 추세는 뚜렷하나 -DI 35.7이 +DI 18.3보다 우위. 4시간봉 RSI 30.9로 과매도 구간 진입. 일봉상 반등 시도 있으나 주봉 및 4시간봉 약세 신호 감안 시 추가 하락 가능성 존재. 따라서 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: Following two consecutive buy entries, the current price of 45,885 KRW is maintained. RSI at 34.5 indicates entry into oversold territory, with MACD histogram at 2.3893 showing sustained improvement. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low at 43,985 KRW and the 20-day low also at 43,985 KRW. Considering ATR of 6,434 KRW, a stop loss of 1.3x ATR (8,364 KRW) from entry at 45,885 KRW would set the stop at 37,521 KRW and target at 64,000 KRW (risk-reward ratio > 1.5). However, weekly RSI is 33.5 and weekly MACD histogram is -7453.6514, indicating a bearish zone. ADX at 30.4 suggests a clear trend, but -DI at 35.7 is stronger than +DI at 18.3. The 4-hour RSI is 30.9, also in oversold territory. Despite attempts at a daily rebound, considering the bearish signals from weekly and 4-hour charts, further downside is possible. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (45,885 KRW) below SMA5 (48,152 KRW), SMA20 (57,996 KRW), and SMA50 (78,704 KRW): diagnosing short- to mid-term trend in a weak position.
· Below SMA100 (96,371 KRW) and SMA200 (112,128 KRW): long-term trend strength is very weak.
· 52-week position (3.5%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (37.3→34.5): entering oversold territory, downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (338.8239→2.3893): holding improvement, weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 40,663 KRW): approaching lower band, band width is wide at 59.77%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (41,000 KRW): based on Pivot S1 (34,092 KRW).
· Swing resistance (47,415 KRW): potential for short-term rebound if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): signal of recovery.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.97x): moderate reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): wait-and-see condition with potential for further decline.
